dataset: EU banking regulatory intelligence golden set

documents.title: ICT and security risk management
documents.content:
# ICT risk management

Article 8 - Governance

Institutions must review and approve their ICT risk management framework at least annually.

Article 11 - Incident reporting

Major ICT-related incidents must be reported to the competent authority without undue delay.

documents.title: Anti-money laundering controls
documents.content:
# Customer due diligence

Article 22 - Beneficial ownership

Credit institutions must identify and verify the beneficial owner before establishing a business relationship.

Article 31 - Record retention

Customer due diligence records must be retained for five years after the relationship ends.

documents.title: Digital operational resilience
documents.content:
# Third-party risk

Article 28 - Register of information

Financial entities must maintain and update a register of all contractual arrangements with ICT third-party service providers.

Article 30 - Contractual provisions

Contracts must specify service level descriptions, data locations and termination rights.

documents.title: Capital requirements
documents.content:
# Prudential reporting

Article 430 - Reporting obligations

Institutions shall report own funds requirements and financial information to competent authorities.

Article 92 - Own funds requirements

The total capital ratio must be at least eight percent of the total risk exposure amount.

documents.title: General Data Protection Regulation
documents.content:
# Security and notification

Article 32 - Security of processing

Controllers must implement technical and organisational measures appropriate to the risk.

Article 33 - Breach notification

A personal data breach must be notified to the supervisory authority within 72 hours where feasible.
